name: seo-keyword-research
summary: Research, expand, cluster, and prioritize SEO keywords and topics with runtime provider availability checks and source-labeled intent evidence.
writes: Home.md review link when review is required
external_reads: approved GA4 or Google Search Console data
approval_gates: provider_availability: run a bounded read-only availability check against approved integration surfaces; do not reveal secrets or probe arbitrary services
external_read: ask before current SERP observation, competitor-page analysis, or other live external reading
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require the applicable approval; DataForSEO and SE Ranking remain first-class sources even when unavailable for a run
vault_write: save only to a resolved project, client, or prospect context when authorized
external_mutation: publishing, CMS, repository, production, and provider configuration changes are out of scope
done_when: research scope, client context, domain/page, market, language, device, date, goal, and seeds are explicit
provider status is recorded for each declared source
keyword set is expanded, filtered, clustered, intent-mapped, and prioritized
source labels and dates distinguish first-party data, provider estimates, observations, competitor evidence, heuristics, hypotheses, and assumptions
clusters include recommended content/page role and rationale
SEO content-brief, Writing, and Strategy handoffs are explicit
durable artifact uses project/client/prospect routing and review frontmatter
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred with an actionable reason
verification: verify unavailable providers produced no fabricated metrics
verify undeclared providers and arbitrary credentials were not probed
verify competitor analysis was approved before external reading
verify provider metrics are not presented as exact truth or outcome guarantees
verify no final copy, metadata prose, CMS change, publishing action, or production mutation occurred
verify changed Markdown/frontmatter and Home review registration when applicable
